name: singlet_ingest_quant_multi_gene_read_assignment
title: Multi-gene molecule allocation
description: Assigns molecules compatible with several genes to genes within each cell, using the equivalence-class table from the UMI collapse step. The default em policy is a maximum-likelihood EM fit; discard, uniform, prop_unique and rescue are fixed rules kept for comparison. Writes allocated counts to layers/counts_allocated, unique-gene counts to layers/counts_unique and ambiguity fractions to obs and var. Do not use it to correct UMIs or collapse reads; that happens upstream.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

multi_gene_policy.description: Allocation rule for molecules compatible with several genes; em is the maximum-likelihood fit, discard keeps unique-gene molecules only.

em.description: Options for the em policy; ignored by the fixed rules.

max_iter.description: Maximum EM iterations per cell (singlet default; the alevin-fry EM caps at 100).

tol.description: Stop when the largest absolute change in molecule counts between iterations falls below this.

zero_floor.description: Components below this are set to zero before each iteration; 0 gives exact EM, 0.01 reproduces STARsolo.

n_bootstrap.description: Molecule-resampling bootstrap refits per cell for intervals; 0 disables them.

ec_granularity.description: Equivalence classes over genes (default) or transcripts; must match the upstream table.

report_tiers.description: Write per-gene tier statistics (tiers 1 to 3) used by the split-half benchmark.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for bootstrap replicates; ignored when em.n_bootstrap is 0.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. layers/counts_allocated. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs. Keys: policy, n_cells, n_molecules, ambiguous_fraction_median, em_converged_fraction, em_iterations_median, tiers (when report_tiers), bootstrap_replicates (when em.n_bootstrap > 0). Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
